summary: Post-evacuation badge suspension + temporary workstation redistribution and inbound courier hold
description:
Issue summary: During a scheduled building evacuation drill on 2026-03-12, the access control system flagged and automatically suspended a batch of employee badges on floors 6-8. Impact: 9 employees were unable to re-enter after the drill and 2 incoming contractor laptops on an outbound courier manifest were placed on hold by building security. Request: coordinate reactivation of legitimate badges, issue temporary visitor tokens where appropriate, verify asset custody for the held shipments, and perform a short-notice redistribution of two workstations to a shared hotdesk area while badge access is validated.

Impact: Productivity disruption for affected staff (engineering and research), potential missed standups and customer calls, and risk of asset hold/escalation from courier if not cleared same-day.

Environment/details: Access control: OnPrem HID/Cobranet system integrated with Okta SSO for badge-to-identity mapping. Affected floors: 6, 7, 8 (main campus). Shipping vendor: RapidParcel (manifest RP-7621), courier hold at loading dock A. Assets on hold: LPC-ENG-101 (contractor laptop), LPC-RND-204 (replacement docking station crate).
steps_to_reproduce:
1) At 09:00 local, facilities triggered a fire-evacuation drill via the building alarm.
2) Building security used the central access panel to simulate a mass-exit.
3) Access system auto-applied "suspended" state to badges associated with exit events due to a legacy safety rule combined with a time-window misconfiguration.
4) Employees attempted to re-enter at 09:28 and received "access denied".
5) Courier presented shipment and was asked to hold by security pending badge reconciliation.
logs: Access-control event IDs: AC-20260312-6F-0001..0009. Okta logs show successful SSO logins for 6 of 9 users prior to drill; subsequent Okta->HID webhook returned 409 conflict for suspended badges. RapidParcel tracking: RP-7621 status: HOLD_BY_SECURITY (2026-03-12T10:12Z). Security camera stills captured at dock A; ticket #SEC-642 attached in security console (link below).
investigation_notes:
Initial hypothesis: safety-rule 'mass-exit suspend' is a legacy configuration intended to prevent tailgating but misfires during drill workflows. Confirmed: rule triggers when >50 badge exits detected within 5 minutes for a single gate and tags those badges as suspended until manual review. Other floors use separate gate IDs; root cause appears to be a consolidated gate mapping in the access control panel that aggregated events across floors.

IT asset note: manifest shows contractor laptop serial matches LPC-ENG-101; contract owner (Talent Ops) confirmed laptop is contractor property for on-site start today. Shipping team confirmed courier will only release with explicit authorization from building security or facilities manager.

Risk: If badges remain suspended beyond business hours, subject employees will be locked out of dedicated GPU pods in the lab and scheduled model training jobs may miss windows.
comments: Nina Patel (reporter) - 2026-03-12: Noticed several team members stuck outside after the drill. Security said badges were 'suspended' pending review. Courier told to hold two packages at dock A. Need quick bypass for engineers to reach critical infra.

Evan Morales (assignee) - 2026-03-12: Reached out to Security (Slack #facilities) and Okta-infra. Requesting temporary visitor tokens for 9 employees tied to their Okta IDs while we review suspend list. Opening follow-up with Access-Control vendor.
Marco Chen (Security) - 2026-03-12: Confirmed RapidParcel hold at dock A. Will not release assets without facilities sign-off. Attached camera snapshots to security console.
Leah Summers (IT-AM) - 2026-03-12: Flagged asset LPC-ENG-101 and LPC-RND-204 in inventory. Will log custody change once courier releases.

Evan Morales - 2026-03-13: Applied one-time manual reactivation to 7 of 9 badges after cross-checking IDs; two remain flagged due to mismatch between badge ID and Okta username (likely swapped badges). Created action: in-person badge swap/verification. Requested Facilities to authorize courier release for manifest RP-7621 after identity verification.
resolution:
Workaround: Manual badge reactivation performed for 7 employees by access-control admin (temporary state expires 2026-03-19). Two employees were issued temporary visitor fobs and scheduled for on-site badge reconciliation with Facilities on 2026-03-14 at 10:30. RapidParcel released the two held assets after Facilities signed Authorization Form F-AUTH-33 and ID checks; IT-AM logged custody transfer for both items.

Permanent fix plan: 1) Remove 'mass-exit suspend' aggregation across floors by splitting gate mapping in the access-control config (work scheduled with vendor for 2026-03-20). 2) Update drill SOP to include pre-notice notification to access-control and courier partners. 3) Add an automation: if badge suspend originates from a scheduled drill window (calendar tag), auto-skip suspend step. Assigned to Facilities and Security to implement.

Status: Partial resolution — operational access restored for affected staff, assets released, but configuration change pending vendor work. Follow-ups scheduled in linked tasks.
